== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Cell 2187 (Japanese)|Cell 2187]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=12640 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(21, 6, 469, 623)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>dc7d166a4aa2d2394be555d38f3ddd93a8278206effd6ab47838af2325fe4a57</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
